translate_en|mods/CompanionCat/42/media/: Not a dog with worse numbers: an animal that simply does not have some of the jobs. A cat never fights the dead, is never posted to a pen, and only breeds with other cats. It hunts rodents and rabbits, and leaves deer alone. Your own animals are never prey: it will not touch a chicken, or anything in a pen. What it gives you instead is warning: it notices the dead further out than any other companion, and it is quiet about everything else. The hardest animal in the family to train, and independent with it: the bond fades faster than a dog's if you neglect it. Every so often it spots a rodent, drops everything and goes after it, ignoring your orders until it is done; only Come brings it back. Common in homes, and turns up at pet shops and veterinary clinics.
Your cat sees what you cannot. While it is fed, watered and bonded to you, the dark stops hiding what you are searching for: foraging at night works close to how it does by day.

Scales how often stray cats appear in houses, shops and pet stores. 1.0 is the normal rate, 2.0 doubles them, 0 turns cat spawns off. This is separate from the dog spawn setting: turning stray dogs down or off no longer takes the cats with them.
